signal: Remi (remihq.com), a Y Combinator roofing-and-solar marketplace, hit $10.5M revenue with a 60-person team and is trusted by national solar provider Sunrun

email.body1:
Nathan, saw Remi scale to $10.5M revenue with a 60-person team and earn Sunrun's trust as the roofing layer behind solar.

Growth that lean usually means more in-market accounts than your reps can cover, and good-fit partners and customers go cold before anyone reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nathan, quick follow-up for Remi.

Running revenue and growth on a 60-person team means every rep hour counts, and pipeline expectations usually climb faster than you can hire. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Remi needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nathan, last bit of proof for Remi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Remi's reply rate likely compares to other venture-backed startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nathan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and owning revenue and growth at a lean startup keeps you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your growth motion? I'll tailor it to Remi either way.
